<p class="white-text">

Welcome to the <strong>Forest Insect and Disturbance Lab</strong> at Utah State University! Our research is focused on how weather, climate, and landscapes affect forest insect herbivores, disturbances, and forest ecosystems. We are especially interested in identifying the mechanisms of <strong> where, when, and how</strong> population irruptions by native forest insect herbivores start to better forecast future outbreaks. 

</p>

## Research Themes 

A) identifying the mechanisms of insect population irruptions at local and landscape scales

B) modeling the consequences of insect-caused disturbance and climate change across forested ecosystems

C) expanding our toolbox for quantifying and forecasting climate change impacts across ecosystems and continents
